# scamp_vault_secret (Resource)

Manages a secret in a Secrets Vault. A new value is stored as a new version; destroy deletes the secret with all its versions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scamp_vault_secret" "gitlab_admin" {
  vault_id = scamp_vault.corp.id
  name     = "gitlab/admin"
  value = jsonencode({
    url      = scamp_managed_app.gitlab.url
    user     = scamp_managed_app.gitlab.admin_user
    password = scamp_managed_app.gitlab.admin_password
  })
}

resource "scamp_vault_secret" "vpn_alice" {
  vault_id = scamp_vault.corp.id
  name     = "vpn/alice-laptop"
  value    = scamp_vpn_device.alice.config
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the secret: lowercase letters, digits, - _ . and / between parts, e.g. gitlab/admin. Changing it replaces the secret.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The value, up to 64 KB. For several fields use jsonencode({...}). A value changed outside Terraform shows as a change and is set back on apply.
- `vault_id` (String) The vault's id (scamp_vault). Changing it replaces the secret.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) VAULT_ID/NAME.
- `version` (Number) The secret's current version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import scamp_vault_secret.gitlab_admin 0a1b2c3d-0000-4000-8000-000000000000/gitlab/admin
```
